hItems.title: Western Bulldogs
hItems.description: Played at least 1 game for the Western Bulldogs, or currently on their list. Includes players who played at least 1 game for Footscray.

hItems.title: MARVEL STADIUM
hItems.subtitle: 50+ GAMES
hItems.description: Played in 50 or more games at Docklands Stadium, currently known as Marvel Stadium (since 2000).

hItems.title: PLAYED IN A FINAL
hItems.description: Played in at least 1 finals game.

vItems.title: ALL AUSTRALIAN
vItems.description: Player has made at least one All-Australian team. Includes VFL Team of the Year (1982-90), and All-Australian teams selected after State of Origin carnivals (1953–1988).

vItems.title: ED RICHARDS
vItems.subtitle: ED RICHARDS TEAMMATE
vItems.description: Player has been a teammate of Ed Richards.
